summary: EQT Private Equity Company LLC filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of its own shares through a continuous private offering. Approximately $16.6 million of Investor Shares were sold to third-party investors at transactional net asset value per share, per class, as of July 31, 2026. The sales were exempt under Section 4(a)(2), Regulation D, and/or Regulation S. The filing also announced updated net asset values per share for each class. This is a routine ongoing offering disclosure, not a special situation.
